findings.new_behavior: With rightleft mode enabled, curscol is now remapped to count from the left side of the window, matching the actual cursor screen column. col and endcol remain in reading order.
findings.old_behavior: With rightleft mode enabled, the curscol value of screenpos() was computed in reading order (same direction as col/endcol), which meant it pointed to the rightmost cell of the character on screen, not where the cursor is actually placed.
findings.test_recommendation: Run the existing test_cursor_func.vim tests, particularly the Test_screenpos_rightleft test. Create before/after comparisons of screenpos() return values with rightleft enabled to confirm curscol now points to the actual cursor screen column.
